brief:
Shehab Wire reported that U.S. President Donald Trump intensified his attacks on a Democratic Senate candidate in a new campaign targeting American voices expressing solidarity with Palestine and opposing unconditional U.S. support for Israel's occupation. The confrontation centers on the candidate's statements, which Trump characterized as reflective of "two very different Americas."

Trump's latest offensive aims to discredit American critics of U.S. alignment with Israel, according to the agency. The candidate's positions on Palestinian rights have become a central flashpoint in the political dispute between the two figures, with Trump using the rhetoric of national division to frame the disagreement.
title: Trump escalates attacks on Democratic Senate candidate over Palestine stance.
